controls.label: Color
controls.qualification: Colour of a blackbody at the star's temperature; darkening toward the edge from a model atmosphere. The disc itself is unresolved.
controls.notes: The colour of a blackbody at the star's published temperature. The darkening toward the edge is the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 3,566 K and log g 4.85 (u1 0.386, u2 0.378): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. The spin axis's direction on the sky is a display convention.

physical.credit: Castro-González et al. 2022, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of K2-95 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive radius; Gaia DR3 astrometry; no measured rotation axis (display convention)
